gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-actor: Pixelify Sans draws every stroke like bent pipe cleaner, one thickness from start to finish, with a c that gapes wide. Actor follows with sans-serif curves in the s that barely curl in, modern and tidy underneath.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-alan-sans: Alan Sans reads crisp and businesslike, its curve tails held well back from the body of each letter, which keeps lines tidy. Paragraphs of it would move along smoothly beneath Pixelify Sans.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-alegreya-sans-sc: Alegreya Sans SC reads friendly and current, with a welcoming gap in every c. Pixelify Sans goes blocky and bold above it, and the two share the page without stepping on each other.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-almarai: Expressive is the mood of Pixelify Sans, with strokes as unvarying as bent wire. Almarai carries a long read comfortably, its sans-serif lines never swelling or tapering and its letters never pinching shut.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-bai-jamjuree: Bai Jamjuree is approachable and light in its round letters, with no thick-and-thin modulation anywhere. And over many lines it stays easygoing, a calm companion to the chunky Pixelify Sans heading.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-barlow: Chunky pixel charm up top, tidy neon-tube strokes below. Pixelify Sans does bold, expressive display work best, and Barlow, a plain sans with c tips pulled well apart, handles the quieter reading.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-biz-udgothic: Bent-tubing letters, loud and playful. BIZ UDGothic then settles in with a wide channel into every bowl, and its text runs easily, line after line, under the Pixelify Sans heading.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-biz-udpgothic: One unmodulated line runs across every glyph of Pixelify Sans, which gives the heading its bold, expressive stamp. And BIZ UDPGothic spaces its letters lavishly, so extended text feels generous and easy to move through.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-chiron-hei-hk: Expressive and a little wild, Pixelify Sans keeps one stroke width through the whole alphabet. Chiron Hei HK sits beside it modern and level-headed, its wide-open c like a bracelet pulled apart.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-exo-2: Pixelify Sans holds one stroke width, bent like a steel rod, with a c open as a paperclip. And Exo 2 keeps its curves full of daylight, so longer text stays clear and comfortable.
